title: Lebesgue measure on R^n
summary: Construction of Lebesgue measure: special rectangles and polygons, measure of open sets by approximation from within and of compact sets from outside, outer and inner measures, Lebesgue measurability first for sets of finite outer measure and then in general, and the proof that (R^n, L, λ) is a measure space.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 6–7 of the 18.125 notes.

preparation.description: Read lecture 6: special rectangles and polygons, measure of open and compact sets, outer and inner measures.
Read lecture 7: Lebesgue measurability for finite outer measure, removal of the restriction, and the proof that L is a σ-algebra and λ a measure.
